description: Qwen 8B legacy NVFP4 block/lane pack; persistent fused projection grid, all 36 layers, context 128, seed 17, BF16 input and random KV prefix. Wall microseconds per layer. Shader validation disabled during timing.
selection: 40 threadgroups (2 per core), KSPLIT=8; reciprocal cached after first tile. 20 groups and larger one-group/core alternatives are slower. Fusion remains opt-in.
limitations: Grid sweep initially hoists reduction before tile loop; late sweep and final implementation cache after first MMA. MLX-resident comparison has substantial timing outliers. T6 confirmation follows an inconsistent original-baseline minimum; all runs retained.

numerical_note: K split changes alter accumulation order; controls are finite with full-stack cosine > .99. The selected KSPLIT=8 variants preserve bit identity.
